signature.why: The threats. All ten current field lists run Cori-Steel Cutter, Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear at four copies each; the deck is one-mana bodies that grow when a spell is cast, and Cutter is what turns the second spell each turn into a second body.

The cheap spells the threats are counting. 10/10 field lists run Bauble, Lava Dart, Bolt and Preordain at 4 each: a prowess deck without a critical mass of zero-and-one-mana spells is an izzet tempo deck that never triggers.
An izzet manabase with fetches, because Dragon's Rage Channeler's delirium and Lava Dart's flashback both want lands in the graveyard and the deck casts two spells a turn from turn two.
